experiment_data.notes: 5-seed cls comparison complete. Seeds: seed0=87.94, seed42=87.83, seed123=89.52, seed456=87.88, seed789=89.00. Cls 5-seed mean=88.43±0.78 (sample std). Traj 5-seed mean=86.30±0.97. Cls outperforms traj by +2.13pp with lower variance (0.78 vs 0.97). All 5 cls seeds pass MVP-B criteria (per-class F1>65%, accuracy gap>=10pp). Classification approach shows consistent advantage over trajectory-level approach across all seeds.
